theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_density_blowup_decay
theorems.statement: DensityExistsAE → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∀ θ₀ τ : ℝ, HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ₀) → τ < θ₀ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
